This example shows one complete way to generate the required Homework 2
output. It is a model, not a script you must follow word for word. The chat
creates the required tables but does not answer or interpret the homework
questions.

::: {.conversation}

::: {.turn .student}
::: {.speaker}
Student
:::

Set up IntroStatGPT for Homework 2. Verify that the workspace is ready, but do
not begin an analysis yet.
:::

::: {.turn .codex}
::: {.speaker}
IntroStatGPT
:::

Setup is complete. The assignment data and required R packages are ready.
:::

## Normal-model calculations

::: {.turn .student}
::: {.speaker}
Student
:::

For Problem 2 part 3, use the supplied normal model with mean 480 units and
standard deviation 75 units. Calculate `Pr(D > 600)` and
`Pr(450 < D < 600)`. Put both probabilities in one clearly labeled table,
show them to four decimal places, and save the table for my report. Do not
write interpretations.
:::

::: {.turn .codex}
::: {.speaker}
IntroStatGPT
:::

Created **T1: Problem 2: Demand probabilities**.

| Event | Probability |
| :--- | ---: |
| Pr(D > 600) | 0.0548 |
| Pr(450 < D < 600) | 0.6006 |
:::

::: {.turn .student}
::: {.speaker}
Student
:::

For Problem 2 part 5, use the same normal model to find the fewest whole
number of units to stock so that `Pr(D > stock) <= 0.01`. Show the normal
cutoff to two decimal places and the whole-number target in a saved table. Do
not write an interpretation.
:::

::: {.turn .codex}
::: {.speaker}
IntroStatGPT
:::

Created **T2: Problem 2: One-percent stock target**.

| Quantity | Value |
| :--- | ---: |
| Normal cutoff (units) | 654.48 |
| Fewest whole number to stock | 655 |
:::

## Workload comparison

::: {.turn .student}
::: {.speaker}
Student
:::

For Problem 5 Output A, use `fulfillment_shifts`. Put shifts with at most 900
orders in one group and shifts with more than 900 orders in another. Make one
table with a column for each group and rows for the number of shifts, mean
completion-time error, sample SD of completion-time error, number of shifts
outside the target from -10 through 10 minutes, and percentage outside the
target. Show means and SDs to three decimal places and percentages to one
decimal place. Save the table for my report. Skip the optional plot and do not
interpret the results.
:::

::: {.turn .codex}
::: {.speaker}
IntroStatGPT
:::

Created **T3: Problem 5 Output A: Completion errors by workload group**.

| Quantity | At most 900 orders | More than 900 orders |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| Number of shifts | 75 | 125 |
| Mean completion-time error (minutes) | 0.327 | −0.700 |
| Sample SD of completion-time error (minutes) | 5.812 | 14.213 |
| Number of shifts outside target | 7 | 55 |
| Percentage of shifts outside target | 9.3% | 44.0% |
:::

## Build the report skeleton

::: {.turn .student}
::: {.speaker}
Student
:::

Create a report called **Homework 2 report skeleton**. Keep all five problem
headings in assignment order, including the problems with no saved output.
Put T1 and T2 under Problem 2 and T3 under Problem 5. Show me the complete
outline before you build it. Do not add source code, interpretations, or
answers.
:::

::: {.turn .codex}
::: {.speaker}
IntroStatGPT
:::

Here is the proposed report outline.

**Problem 1. Evaluate an event-equipment contract**

**Problem 2. Set an inventory target with a normal demand model:** T1, T2

**Problem 3. Which routing tool resolves tickets faster?**

**Problem 4. Evaluating a transaction-screening algorithm**

**Problem 5. Are busy shifts equally predictable?** T3

Describe any changes, or approve this outline to build the Word report.
:::

::: {.turn .student}
::: {.speaker}
Student
:::

I approve this outline. Build the Word report.
:::

::: {.turn .codex}
::: {.speaker}
IntroStatGPT
:::

Built version 1 of the [Homework 2 report skeleton](../files/homework-02-report-skeleton.docx).
:::

:::

## What to do next

Open the Word skeleton, add your numbered answers under the corresponding
problem headings, insert your three Problem 2 sketches, and export the
completed document to PDF. The supplied skeleton is also available as a
backup if IntroStatGPT does not finish your report or as a check on output you
generated yourself.
